# Local Lean native boundary

The generated ABI-15 parser and all upstream inputs remain unchanged. The active scanner uses fixed checked indentation state, canonical bounded wire, transactional rollback, finite delimiter bounds and request-scoped accepted scanner work/cancellation. The separate status unit and Rc-owned callback scope must cover parser acquisition through finish; parser leases are withheld during an operation. Native soft refusal permits exact source preservation only under the explicit default policy.

Memory enforcement is unavailable. Scanner step credit does not bound total parser work or heap. Standard Rc allocation is infallible; this is not hard accounting. The nine C groups and unchanged original CST are isolated operational evidence, not Rust/product qualification. Rust and integrated controls remain unexecuted.

Builds compile complete reviewed local parser/scanner/status and pinned local dependencies; they do not run upstream scripts, generate code, or acquire sources.
